line: Run root-access virtual servers on Swiss cloud infrastructure.

work.math: CHF 1.65 a day, times 730 hours divided by 24 hours a day = CHF 50.1875 a month. 100 GB a month assumes total traffic stays below 100 GB a day. Before VAT.
CHF 1.10 a day, times 730 hours divided by 24 hours a day = CHF 33.4583 a month. 100 GB a month assumes total traffic stays below 100 GB a day. No request fee is listed.
